abdomen_measured: Measured: front arc {front} mm · lumbar hollow {back} mm
abdomen_method: Measured on the midline, front and back, at 45 % of the height from the crotch to the jugular notch; the line it is measured from joins 25 % and 70 %. A fixed way of measuring, not a bony landmark.
app_needs_service: This page has to be opened by the local service, which makes the models:
blend_broken: Refused to export the .blend, because the mesh is broken: {reasons}
blend_no_blender: Needs Blender. Install it, or set BLENDER=/path/to/blender, then restart the editor.
blend_superseded: Replaced by another .blend export, such as one from another open page.
compare_hint: Hold to see the model before the last change; let go to come back
contact_broken: Refused to export with IPC contact, because the mesh is broken: {reasons}
contact_preparing: IPC export · getting ready to bake · {clock}
contact_superseded: Replaced by another IPC export, such as one from another open page.
error_superseded: Replaced by another request, such as one from another open page.
failure_contact_hang: The hanging-arm contact correction failed and isn't used: the forearm and hand may pass into the hip and thigh when the arms hang relaxed ({detail})
failure_contact_pelvic: The groin contact correction failed and the static sculpt is used: the thigh and the lower belly may pass through each other in a deep hip bend ({detail})
failure_contact_shoulder: The armpit contact correction failed and the old one is used: the upper arm and the side of the chest may pass through each other when the arm is raised ({detail})
failure_ground: The sole is {mm} mm off the ground
failure_miss: {part} seam misses by {share} of the limb's radius, over {limit}
failure_open_skin: The skin isn't closed (edges without exactly two faces: {count}). These are the template's faces, not from any parameter
file_format: Not a parameter file: its format is {format}
file_newer: The file's version {version} is newer than this editor, which reads up to {latest}
file_not_object: Not a parameter file: the top level must be an object
file_not_parameters: {group} must be an object of parameters
file_sex_missing: sex must name whose body this is, such as "female"
follow_hint: The camera turns to a group's part when it's picked
glb_broken: Refused to export the GLB, because the mesh is broken: {reasons}
import_unknown_fields: Kept the fields it doesn't know: {fields}
inspect_hint: Shading, expressions, parts and model information
inspector_note: Changes only how the body is seen: at once, without generating, and not written to the parameter file.
look_matcap_hint: Sculpting clay: small bumps, dents and flattened places
look_silhouette_hint: One flat colour: proportions, outline and the gaps between limbs and torso
look_xray_hint: See-through skin and bones: whether the joints sit inside the forms
mend_dismiss: Dismiss the message about finding a parameter
mend_failed: Couldn't look for a parameter that fixes it: {error}
mend_found: Moving {name} from {before} back to the typical body's share, {after}, ends the damage; other parameters may too
mend_none: Tried {total} parameters: moving back any one alone doesn't fix it. See the parts named above
mend_preparing: Looking for a parameter that fixes it: wrapping once more · {clock}
mend_running: Looking for a parameter that fixes it: trying {tried} of {total} · {clock}
panel_no_changes: Nothing changed yet. Sliders you move are listed here, to check and reset one by one.
row_awaiting: The preset's measured value shows once generated
row_breast_needed: Base width, fold height, upper fullness and gap can be set once projection is above 0.
row_zone_seam: This stretch generates, but seams may have problems: {reasons}
rule_ankle_high_foot: The ankle is too high for the foot length
rule_ankle_low_foot: The ankle is too low for the foot length
rule_ankle_thick_foot: The ankle is too thick for the foot
rule_ankle_thick_foot_knee: The ankle is too thick for the foot and knee; the foot won't join
rule_ankle_thin_foot: The ankle is too thin for the foot
rule_arm_clear_ribs: The inside of the arm touches the ribs
rule_arm_thick_high_shoulder: The upper arm is too thick for shoulders this high
rule_arm_thick_narrow_shoulders: The upper arm is too thick for shoulders this narrow
rule_foot_long_body: The foot is too long for the body
rule_foot_long_knee: The foot is too long for the knee height
rule_hand_big_forearm: The hand is too big for the forearm
rule_hand_big_forearm_arm: The hand is too big for the forearm and upper arm; the wrist would fold
rule_hip_shallow_thigh: The hip is too shallow for the thigh
rule_knee_wide_calf: The knee is too thick for the calf
rule_neck_thick_head: The neck is too thick for the head
rule_neck_thin_head: The neck is too thin for the head
rule_neck_thin_length: The neck is too thin for its length
rule_pectoral_under_breast_thin: With a breast, the pectorals can only be thin for now
rule_shoulders_clear_chest: The shoulders don't reach far enough past the ribcage
rule_thigh_thin_hip: The thigh is too thin for the hip width
rule_torso_long_head: The torso is too long for the head
rule_wrist_thick_hand: The wrist is too thick for the hand
rule_wrist_thick_hand_arm: The wrist is too thick for the hand and arm; the hand won't join
rule_wrist_thin_arm: The wrist is too thin for the arm
slider_abdomenFrontArc_help: How far the front of the belly sits off the line joining above and below it. Zero is on the line; positive bulges forward, negative draws in. Measured at a fixed place, which doesn't move with Waist transition height.
slider_acromionRise_help: How far the acromion sits above the jugular notch; negative is lower. In real women it is a little higher; median about +6 mm.
slider_shoulderSetback_help: How far the shoulders and arms stand behind where they do by default, in millimetres. 0 leaves them. The back and neck stay, so from the side the arm sits closer to the back, and the shoulder bones go with it.
slider_ankleGirth_help: Around the narrowest place above the ankle, solved to a measurement. Real women: median about 215 mm.
slider_ankleHeight_help: The ankle joint's height off the ground. Real women: median about 63 mm (outer ankle), about 0.26 of the foot length; the template's foot needs it between 0.32 and 0.55 of the foot length, so it is higher than real.
slider_biacromialBreadth_help: Between the two acromions. The shoulders' surface is a little wider. Real women: median about 365 mm. The presets are all narrower, an anime style. Their front-to-back place is the shoulder setback.
slider_breastBaseBreadth_help: The left-to-right width of where the breast attaches to the chest wall. The attachment's height takes the same value, near a circle, measured up from the fold.
slider_breastFoldDrop_help: How far below the jugular notch the breast's lower edge (where it meets the chest wall, the inframammary fold) sits. The larger, the lower the whole breast.
slider_breastGap_help: Between the inner edges of the two attachments. At 0 they meet at the midline; below 0 they lap over it, lifting the skin between them so the two close up. The front points are about this plus twice the front point's outward share of the base width apart (one base width when it is in the middle).
slider_breastApexRatio_help: The share of the attachment's width between its inner edge and the front point. At 0.5 the front point is in the middle; real women's nipples lie about 0.64 of the way out, with a long inner slope and a short outer one.
slider_breastProjection_help: How far the breast's front point stands off the surface under it (ribcage or pectorals): the largest thickness. 0 is no breast. Coming up from 0, the four below start from the slim build's proportions. Not a bust-minus-underbust figure or a cup size.
slider_breastUpperPoleRatio_help: The share of the attachment's height above the front point (the upper pole). No unit; the larger, the lower the front point. The 45:55 upper-to-lower poles plastic surgery often cites reads 0.45.
slider_calfGirth_help: Around the calf's thickest place, solved to a measurement. Real women: median about 372 mm.
slider_chestBreadth_help: The ribcage's width at nipple height, solved to a measurement. It measures the ribcage alone, without the arms or the hollow of the armpit, so the finished body can be narrower at this height. Real women: median about 268 mm.
slider_chestDepth_help: Front to back at nipple height, without the breast, solved to a measurement. Real women: median about 245 mm, but real data includes the breast.
slider_crotchHeight_help: Crotch to the ground, the length of the leg. Changes only the stature and the legs; the knee height follows in proportion, widths and arms stay. Real women: median about 780 mm.
slider_curve_help: An editing tool: more upper-body lean back and pelvic tilt, a narrower waist and wider hips, so the front changes too. 0 changes nothing; the gains are a first guess without a basis in real bodies.
slider_deltoidThickness_help: Added to the shoulder cap: a larger radius and a centre moved outwards; it grows only outwards, never into the armpit. 0 is the build as it is. An amount added to the inner form, not a measurement of the finished surface.
slider_footLength_help: Heel to toe; the foot scales as a whole. Real women: median about 246 mm.
slider_lowerArmLength_help: Elbow to wrist. Real women: median about 240 mm.
slider_fullness_help: An editing tool: rewrites the thigh, upper arm, knee, calf, neck and the hip's width and depth in proportion, each into its own parameter. Waist, ribcage and bust are not touched. 0 changes nothing; the proportions are design values without a basis in real bodies.
slider_gluteFoldDepth_help: How far the skin draws in at the fold's deepest point from where it would be without one. 0 is no fold. Not the depth one sees: measured from the swellings either side to the bottom, it is usually shallower.
slider_gluteFoldLength_help: One side's gluteal fold, inside to outside, measured at both ends to where it is half as deep. Does nothing while the fold's depth is 0.
slider_glutePeakShift_help: How far up the seat's fullest point moves from where it would be. 0 is the build as it is.
slider_gluteLowerFullness_help: How far back the outline moves 0.10 torso lengths below the peak, without moving the peak. How much it can go depends on how steep this body's back outline is; at the end the page says where it actually got.
slider_gluteProjection_help: How far back the seat's surface moves from where it would be. 0 is the build as it is; the hip width stays.
slider_gluteUpperFullness_help: How far back the outline moves 0.12 torso lengths above the peak, without moving the peak. How much it can go depends on how steep this body's back outline is; at the end the page says where it actually got.
slider_groinDepth_help: Standing, how far the skin draws back at the groin's deepest point from where it would be without a fold. 0 is none; the far right is the default shape, and it can only be made shallower. Not the depth one sees: the forms either side rise and fall too. The shapes of a bent hip don't follow it.
slider_groinRelief_help: Standing, how far forward the skin sits at the lower belly's fullest point, compared with leaving this out; the thigh root follows in a fixed proportion. 0 is no swell; the far right is the default shape, and it can only be made lighter. The shapes of a bent hip don't follow it.
slider_handLength_help: Wrist to the farthest fingertip; the hand scales as a whole. Real women: median about 180 mm.
slider_headDepth_help: The head's front-to-back depth, in head heights. The actual depth is about 0.92 times the value; a real head's length is about 0.88 of its height. Features and hair not included.
slider_headWidthRatio_help: Head width over head height: the head's own proportion, kept when the head is scaled. Real heads are about 0.68 (head height estimated at 7.5 heads). Hair not included.
slider_headHeight_help: Chin to the top of the head. The head scales as a whole and the stature with it; nothing else moves. Real women: median about 217 mm. (estimated at 7.5 heads)
slider_heads_help: Stature over head height, a reading. Dragging it keeps the stature and rewrites the head height, neck length, crotch height, torso length and the girths in one go, each into its own parameter. How they follow comes from the project's own designed builds, not from growth data. Real adults are about 7.5.
slider_hipDepth_help: The hip's largest front-to-back distance, solved to a measurement, without the local shaping such as projection. Real women (buttock depth): median about 231 mm.
slider_hipBreadth_help: The widest place from just below to just above the crotch, calibrated to ±2 % on generating. Real women: median about 353 mm. Also places the hip joints and so the thickness of the thigh root.
slider_jawBreadthRatio_help: The jaw's breadth at its widest over the head's, which sets the chin's width with it. 0.604 is the most pointed, 0.82 the roundest.
slider_kneeGirth_help: Around the knee joint, solved to a measurement. Also moves the knees and ankles left and right.
slider_kneeHeight_help: The knee joint's height off the ground. The leg's length stays: right raises the knee, so the shin lengthens and the thigh shortens as much. Real women: median about 465 mm., about 0.60 of the crotch height.
slider_latissimusThickness_help: Added to the latissimus: its upper end spreads outwards and back and thickens, which shows from behind. 0 is the build as it is. An amount added to the inner form, not a measurement of the finished surface.
slider_legClearance_help: The gap between the knees and between the feet, which keeps the legs from passing through each other. Not how far apart the feet stand.
slider_lumbarHollow_help: How far the small of the back sits in from the line joining above and below it. Zero is on the line; the larger, the deeper the hollow. Shapes only the surface; the pelvis's tilt stays.
slider_neckGirth_help: Around the neck just below the chin, solved to a measurement. Real women: median about 328 mm.
slider_neckLength_help: Jugular notch to chin. Changes only the stature and the neck. Real women: median about 83 mm. (estimated at 7.5 heads)
slider_outerHipShift_help: How far up the widest place seen from the front moves from where it would be; the widest value stays about the same. 0 is the build as it is.
slider_outerThighArc_help: 25 % of the way from the crotch to the knee, how far the leg's outer edge sits off the line joining above and below. Zero is on the line; positive bulges outwards. The line joins 0.05 torso lengths above the crotch and 70 % of the way to the knee. The upper girth and the front's thickness are kept, and the girth is made up at the back and side; where that runs out, the range ends.
slider_pectoralThickness_help: How much the front of the chest thickens at the lower edge of the pectorals. Nothing under the collarbone or on the sternum's midline; it thickens downwards and falls away soon past the edge. 0 is no pectorals. An amount added to the inner form, not a measurement of the finished surface. With a breast, it can only be thin for now.
slider_pelvisLean_help: Seen from the side, how far the middle of the lower belly (0.25 torso lengths above the crotch) sits in front of the middle of the hip (0.05 above). Solved to a measurement and made by tilting the pelvis's form, without moving bones. Not the pelvic tilt measured between the iliac spines in real bodies.
slider_stature_help: The sum of the four lengths, a reading. Dragging it scales every millimetre of the body, keeping the shape. Real women: median about 1626 mm.
slider_taper_help: An editing tool: slims the knees, wrists and ankles, makes the hands and feet smaller and slims the neck, each into its own parameter. 0 changes nothing; the gains are a first guess without a basis in real bodies.
slider_thighFrontShift_help: Shapes the thigh's soft tissue front and back along the fixed femur, keeping the middle's girth about the same. The value is how far the middle moves.
slider_tone_help: Strengthens the muscles' relief and tightens the blending radius together. Stronger muscle also thickens the neck and thighs. 0 changes nothing; the gains are a first guess without a basis in real bodies.
slider_torsoLength_help: Jugular notch to crotch. Changes only the stature and the torso; widths and arms stay. Real women: median about 546 mm.
slider_trapeziusThickness_help: Added to the trapezius: thickens and raises its end at the side of the neck, so the line from neck to shoulder is steeper. 0 is the build as it is. An amount added to the inner form, not a measurement of the finished surface.
slider_upperArmGirth_help: Around the middle of the upper arm, solved to a measurement. Real women: median about 304 mm flexed, a little less relaxed.
slider_upperArmLength_help: Shoulder joint to elbow. Real women: median about 311 mm (acromion to elbow).
slider_upperThighGirth_help: Around one leg's level cross-section, 25 % of the way from the crotch to the knee. The girth sets the overall thickness first, then the outer arc shares out the shape. The outer arc is kept as the girth changes; the skeleton doesn't move with the thickness. The value is in millimetres, and the finished body's measurements are listed below.
slider_upperTrunkLean_help: Seen from the side, how far the middle of the upper chest (0.85 torso lengths above the crotch) sits behind the middle of the waist (0.45 above). Solved to a measurement and made by tilting the ribcage's form, without moving bones or changing the chest's depth.
slider_waistContourShift_help: Shares the outline between ribcage and pelvis differently, without moving the skeleton. Up lengthens the lower part and gathers the upper; the waist's width is set apart.
slider_waistBreadth_help: The measured width at the waistline, calibrated to ±2 % on generating. Real women: median about 298 mm (at the navel). Most presets are narrower, an anime style.
slider_wristGirth_help: Around the arm just above the wrist, solved to a measurement. Real women: median about 154 mm.
start_imported_note: The body is an imported file. Picking one replaces it with that typical body.
start_replaces: Picking a preset replaces the current body. It can be undone.
status_broken: Generated, but the mesh is broken, so it can't be exported
status_failed_previous: Generating failed. Showing the last valid model
status_hint_idle: The model stays still while dragging and is generated on release. Several sliders in a row count once, for the last.
status_hint_retry: Move a slider or click Export GLB to try again.
status_hint_unreachable: The page has to be opened by pnpm run editor, and Python has to run. First, in the repository:
status_invalid: The parameters are invalid; nothing was generated
status_invalid_previous: The parameters are invalid; nothing was generated. Showing the last valid model
surface_hipTissueMidline: The hip's soft tissue crosses the midline
surface_hipBreadth: The measured hip width doesn't match the parameter
surface_kneeCentre: The knee's cross-section is off centre
surface_legsPart: The legs don't part at the crotch
surface_waistBreadth: The measured waist width doesn't match the parameter
surface_wristCentre: The wrist's cross-section is off centre
thigh_measured: Measured: upper girth {girth} mm · outer arc {arc} mm
thigh_method: Measured 25 % of the way from the crotch to the knee; the outer line joins 0.05 torso lengths above the crotch and 70 % of the way to the knee. The sliders' ranges follow the current body.
thigh_pending: Hip and thigh measurements: shown once generated
timing_cached: This model came from the cache: waited {seconds} s
timing_detail:
This model waited {waited} s, of which generating {total} s
fitting {wrap}, rigging {rig}, head and parts {parts} (at the same time)
top_blend_note: The rigged file for Blender: control bones, constraints, correctives and joint limits. Exports the parameters as they are at the click; usually takes under half a minute, and the sliders stay free meanwhile.
top_contact_note: Bakes the contact tables of the armpit, the groin and the hanging arm. A body never baked usually takes 15–30 minutes; one baked before is ready at once. Exports the parameters as they are at the click; the sliders stay free meanwhile.
top_reset_all_hint: Put every parameter back to the preset's value
touch_dismiss: Dismiss the note about the contact pose
touch_none: This pose has no solution for this body.
touch_running: Solving the contact pose for this body
touch_short: This body's hand doesn't get there: what's shown is its nearest try, {mm} mm off.
viewport_hint: Click the body to pick a part · drag to turn · scroll to zoom
